description: The sale addresses around a place whose sun goes down (or comes up) into the sea, month by month, with how far the shore is and their latest sale. Worked out from OpenStreetMap for France's sale addresses within 300 m of the coast: the sun's direction must reach the shore past no building but the home's own, no wood, no dune but a narrow one at the door, no cliff upwards, then cross open water. A ground-level estimate: floors, trees and relief are not known. An address missing here may still see the sea from upstairs; say so rather than that it has no view. The same view shows as sea_view on the sales of sales_at_address, recent_sales and appraise_listing.

address.description: Street address with its postcode or city (e.g. "17 rue Gambey, 75011 Paris"), located where its sales were recorded (else its street's). Ignored when lat and lng are given.

limit.description: Addresses returned, nearest first (default 25, at most 100).

place.description: City, city start or postcode (e.g. "Carnac", "Paris 11e", "75011"); with address, the place it is in. Ignored when lat and lng are given.

sun.description: Only addresses that see the sun set (sunset) or rise (sunrise) into the sea; default any.

name: sea_views
title: Homes with a sea view (France)
